build_ViewAppearanceFlow_model: build a ViewAppearanceFlow model with an encoder, decoder, and angle transformer for view synthesis
build_Tatarchenko_model: build a Tatarchenko model with an encoder, decoder, and angle transformer for direct image synthesis
run_ViewAppearanceFlow_forward: run the ViewAppearanceFlow forward pass on a batch with images and camera poses to get loss and predictions
run_ViewAppearanceFlow_forward_angle: run the ViewAppearanceFlow forward_angle method to synthesize images for multiple camera poses
run_Tatarchenko_forward: run the Tatarchenko forward pass on a batch with images and camera poses to get loss and predictions
